<script id="healio-consent-defaults" type="text/javascript">
window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
function gtag(){dataLayer.push(arguments);}

// OneTrust category -> GCM mapping (mirrors GTM OneTrust CMP gcmMapping).
var healioGcmMapping = [
  { gcm: 'analytics_storage', cat: 'C0002' },
  { gcm: 'ad_storage', cat: 'C0004' },
  { gcm: 'functionality_storage', cat: 'C0003' },
  { gcm: 'personalization_storage', cat: 'C0004' },
  { gcm: 'security_storage', cat: 'C0003' },
  { gcm: 'ad_user_data', cat: 'C0004' },
  { gcm: 'ad_personalization', cat: 'C0004' }
];

function healioGcmFromCategoryState(isGranted) {
  return isGranted ? 'granted' : 'denied';
}

function healioGetOptanonConsentCookie() {
  try {
    var match = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|;\s*)OptanonConsent=([^;]*)/);
    return match ? decodeURIComponent(match[1]) : '';
  } catch (e) {
    return '';
  }
}

function healioIsCategoryInCookie(cookie, catId) {
  if (!cookie || !catId) return false;
  return cookie.toUpperCase().indexOf(catId.toUpperCase() + ':1') !== -1;
}

function healioBuildGcmUpdate(categoryStateFn) {
  var update = {};
  for (var i = 0; i < healioGcmMapping.length; i++) {
    var row = healioGcmMapping[i];
    update[row.gcm] = healioGcmFromCategoryState(categoryStateFn(row.cat));
  }
  return update;
}

function healioGcmUpdateFromCookie(cookie) {
  return healioBuildGcmUpdate(function (catId) {
    return healioIsCategoryInCookie(cookie, catId);
  });
}

function healioNormalizeActiveGroups(activeGroups) {
  if (activeGroups === undefined || activeGroups === null) return '';
  return String(activeGroups).replace(/^,|,$/g, '').trim();
}

function healioGcmUpdateFromActiveGroups(activeGroups) {
  var normalized = healioNormalizeActiveGroups(activeGroups);
  if (!normalized) return null;
  var groups = ',' + normalized + ',';
  return healioBuildGcmUpdate(function (catId) {
    return groups.indexOf(',' + catId + ',') !== -1;
  });
}

function healioApplyGcmUpdate(update) {
  if (!update) return;
  gtag('consent', 'update', update);
}

// Optional advanced consent mode features (Google guide). Values match GTM Consent Mode default tags (workspace 335).
gtag('set', 'url_passthrough', false);
gtag('set', 'ads_data_redaction', false);

// 1. Strict defaults for opt-in regions (EEA, UK, Quebec, Brazil) — mirrors GTM "Consent Mode - Defaults - EEA Regions".
gtag('consent', 'default', {
  'ad_storage': 'denied',
  'ad_user_data': 'denied',
  'ad_personalization': 'denied',
  'analytics_storage': 'denied',
  'functionality_storage': 'denied',
  'personalization_storage': 'denied',
  'security_storage': 'denied',
  'region': ['EEA', 'GB', 'CA-QC', 'BR'],
  'wait_for_update': 0
});

// 2. Fallback defaults for the rest of the world (opt-out regions) — mirrors GTM "Consent Mode - Defaults - All Regions".
gtag('consent', 'default', {
  'ad_storage': 'granted',
  'ad_user_data': 'granted',
  'ad_personalization': 'granted',
  'analytics_storage': 'granted',
  'functionality_storage': 'granted',
  'personalization_storage': 'granted',
  'security_storage': 'granted'
});

// Returning visitors: bootstrap GCM from OptanonConsent before OneTrust finishes (mirrors GTM_OneTrustTemplate.js).
var healioConsentCookie = healioGetOptanonConsentCookie();
if (healioConsentCookie) {
  healioApplyGcmUpdate(healioGcmUpdateFromCookie(healioConsentCookie));
}

// Live groups from OneTrust. Skip when empty so regional defaults are not overwritten pre-decision.
window.healioApplyOneTrustConsent = function () {
  healioApplyGcmUpdate(healioGcmUpdateFromActiveGroups(window.OnetrustActiveGroups));
};

// Preference-center changes (mirrors GTM otEventListeners registration).
window.otEventListeners = window.otEventListeners || [];
window.otEventListeners.push({
  event: 'consent.changed',
  listener: function () {
    if (typeof window.healioApplyOneTrustConsent === 'function') {
      window.healioApplyOneTrustConsent();
    }
  }
});

// OneTrust group updates (banner, geo-rule, preference center) — update GCM on the same page before navigation.
window.addEventListener('OneTrustGroupsUpdated', function () {
  if (typeof window.healioApplyOneTrustConsent === 'function') {
    window.healioApplyOneTrustConsent();
  }
});

window.healioConsentDefaultsSet = true;

</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
// WyConsent strict mode: ON by default for all users (OneTrust gating enforced).
// Emergency opt-out (per browser, no redeploy): ?wyconsent=off or localStorage "wyconsent_strict"="0".
// Re-enable with ?wyconsent=on (clears the opt-out). ?wyconsent=debug forces strict on and
// enables the debug overlay/logging; the overlay UI is loaded separately (for example, by GTM).
(function () {
  var strict = true;
  try {
    var qs = window.location.search || "";
    var wyParam = null;
    if (typeof URLSearchParams !== "undefined") {
      wyParam = new URLSearchParams(qs).get("wyconsent");
    } else {
      var m = qs.match(/(?:^|[?&])wyconsent=([^&]*)(?:&|$)/);
      wyParam = m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : null;
    }

    if (wyParam === "debug" && window.localStorage) {
      window.localStorage.setItem("wyconsent_debug", "1");
    }

    // Emergency kill switch (and re-enable), persisted per browser.
    if (window.localStorage) {
      if (wyParam === "off") {
        window.localStorage.setItem("wyconsent_strict", "0");
      } else if (wyParam === "on") {
        window.localStorage.removeItem("wyconsent_strict");
      }
      if (window.localStorage.getItem("wyconsent_strict") === "0") {
        strict = false;
      }
    }
  } catch (eStrict) { }
  window.healioConsentStrict = strict;
})();

// OneTrust category IDs - confirmed mapping (per OneTrust admin -> Google Consent Mode):
//   C0001 Strictly Necessary
//   C0002 Performance      -> analytics_storage
//   C0003 Functional       -> functionality_storage, security_storage
//   C0004 Targeting        -> ad_storage, ad_user_data, ad_personalization, personalization_storage
//   C0005 Social Media
window.WyConsent = window.WyConsent || {};
(function (wy) {
  wy.groups = {
    strictlyNecessary: "C0001",
    performance: "C0002",
    functional: "C0003",
    targeting: "C0004",
    socialMedia: "C0005"
  };

  var TARGETING_GROUP = wy.groups.targeting;

  // ?wyconsent=debug or localStorage wyconsent_debug enables console logging. The visual overlay is loaded separately.
  wy._isDebug = false;
  try {
    wy._isDebug = (window.location.search.indexOf("wyconsent=debug") > -1) ||
      (window.localStorage && localStorage.getItem("wyconsent_debug") === "1");
  } catch (e0) { }
  function logDebug() {
    if (!wy._isDebug || !window.console || !console.log) return;
    try { console.log.apply(console, ["[WyConsent]"].concat(Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments))); } catch (e) { }
  }

  function getGroupsString() {
    if (typeof OnetrustActiveGroups !== "undefined" && OnetrustActiveGroups !== null && String(OnetrustActiveGroups).length > 0)
      return String(OnetrustActiveGroups);
    try {
      var dl = window.dataLayer;
      if (dl && dl.length) {
        for (var i = dl.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
          var o = dl[i];
          if (o && typeof o.OnetrustActiveGroups === "string")
            return o.OnetrustActiveGroups;
        }
      }
    } catch (e) { }
    return "";
  }

  wy.hasGroup = function (groupId) {
    if (!groupId) return false;
    var g = getGroupsString();
    if (!g) return false;
    return ("," + g + ",").indexOf("," + groupId + ",") !== -1;
  };

  wy.hasStrictlyNecessary = function () { return wy.hasGroup(wy.groups.strictlyNecessary); };
  wy.hasPerformance = function () { return wy.hasGroup(wy.groups.performance); };
  wy.hasFunctional = function () { return wy.hasGroup(wy.groups.functional); };
  wy.hasTargeting = function () { return wy.hasGroup(TARGETING_GROUP); };
  wy.hasSocialMedia = function () { return wy.hasGroup(wy.groups.socialMedia); };

  wy.isStrict = function () { return window.healioConsentStrict !== false; };

  // Decision helpers - single source of truth for ad/analytics/identity gating.
  // Strict-flag-off short-circuits every helper to "allowed" (legacy behavior).
  wy.canTrackAnalytics = function () {
    if (!wy.isStrict()) return true;
    return wy.hasPerformance();
  };
  wy.canTrackAdvertising = function () {
    if (!wy.isStrict()) return true;
    return wy.hasTargeting();
  };
  wy.canPersonalize = function () {
    if (!wy.isStrict()) return true;
    return wy.hasTargeting();
  };
  wy.canSendUserId = function () {
    if (!wy.isStrict()) return true;
    return wy.hasTargeting() && wy.hasPerformance();
  };

  // whenConsentResolved - runs fn once OneTrust has published a decision (groups string non-empty
  // OR OneTrustGroupsUpdated has fired at least once). Strict-flag-off runs fn immediately.
  wy._consentResolved = false;
  wy._resolveQueue = [];
  function flushResolveQueue() {
    var q = wy._resolveQueue;
    wy._resolveQueue = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < q.length; i++) {
      try { q[i](); } catch (e) { logDebug("whenConsentResolved cb error", e); }
    }
  }
  function markResolved() {
    if (wy._consentResolved) return;
    wy._consentResolved = true;
    logDebug("consent resolved", getGroupsString());
    flushResolveQueue();
  }
  wy.whenConsentResolved = function (fn) {
    if (typeof fn !== "function") return;
    if (!wy.isStrict() || wy._consentResolved) {
      try { fn(); } catch (e) { logDebug("whenConsentResolved cb error", e); }
      return;
    }
    wy._resolveQueue.push(fn);
  };

  // Deferred gates - run fn now if consented, otherwise queue and run on next consent grant.
  wy._adQueue = [];
  wy._anQueue = [];
  wy.gateForAdvertising = function (fn) {
    if (typeof fn !== "function") return;
    if (wy.canTrackAdvertising()) {
      try { fn(); } catch (e) { logDebug("gateForAdvertising cb error", e); }
      return;
    }
    wy._adQueue.push(fn);
  };
  wy.gateForAnalytics = function (fn) {
    if (typeof fn !== "function") return;
    if (wy.canTrackAnalytics()) {
      try { fn(); } catch (e) { logDebug("gateForAnalytics cb error", e); }
      return;
    }
    wy._anQueue.push(fn);
  };

  // revokeAdvertising - clear in-memory ad identity when targeting consent flips off.
  // Replaces the old Visitor.location.isgdprcompliant branch (now applied globally per strict policy).
  wy.revokeAdvertising = function () {
    try {
      if (window.Visitor) {
        window.Visitor.acceptscookies = false;
        window.Visitor.persistentcontactid = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000";
        window.Visitor.specialcontactid = "";
      }
      window.healioSegments = [];
      window.eh2 = "";
      if (window.localStorage) {
        var keys = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
          var k = localStorage.key(i);
          if (k && (k.indexOf("healio_segments_") === 0 || k === "segids" || k === "segids_ts"))
            keys.push(k);
        }
        for (var j = 0; j < keys.length; j++) localStorage.removeItem(keys[j]);
      }
      logDebug("revokeAdvertising complete");
    } catch (e) { logDebug("revokeAdvertising error", e); }
  };

  wy.onGroupChange = function (groupId, cb) {
    if (!groupId || typeof cb !== "function") return;
    wy._groupCbs = wy._groupCbs || {};
    if (!wy._groupCbs[groupId]) wy._groupCbs[groupId] = [];
    wy._groupCbs[groupId].push(cb);
    try { cb(wy.hasGroup(groupId)); } catch (e1) { }
  };

  wy.onTargetingChange = function (cb) {
    wy.onGroupChange(TARGETING_GROUP, cb);
  };

  function notifyGroupListeners() {
    var map = wy._groupCbs;
    if (!map) return;
    for (var gid in map) {
      if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(map, gid)) continue;
      var ok = wy.hasGroup(gid);
      var cbs = map[gid];
      if (!cbs || !cbs.length) continue;
      for (var j = 0; j < cbs.length; j++) {
        try { cbs[j](ok); } catch (e2) { }
      }
    }
  }

  // processConsentChange - flush queues if granted, scrub if denied. Called on OneTrustGroupsUpdated
  // and OneTrust.OnConsentChanged so both paths apply consent decisions consistently.
  function processConsentChange() {
    markResolved();
    if (wy.canTrackAdvertising()) {
      var aq = wy._adQueue; wy._adQueue = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < aq.length; i++) {
        try { aq[i](); } catch (e) { logDebug("ad queue cb error", e); }
      }
    } else {
      wy.revokeAdvertising();
    }
    if (wy.canTrackAnalytics()) {
      var anq = wy._anQueue; wy._anQueue = [];
      for (var k = 0; k < anq.length; k++) {
        try { anq[k](); } catch (e) { logDebug("analytics queue cb error", e); }
      }
    }
  }

  function notifyDebugListeners() {
    if (!wy._isDebug) return;
    try {
      if (typeof window.CustomEvent === "function") {
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("WyConsentDebugUpdated"));
      } else {
        var evt = document.createEvent("Event");
        evt.initEvent("WyConsentDebugUpdated", true, true);
        window.dispatchEvent(evt);
      }
    } catch (eDbg) { }
  }

  function onConsentEvent() {
    notifyGroupListeners();
    processConsentChange();
    notifyDebugListeners();
  }

  window.addEventListener("OneTrustGroupsUpdated", onConsentEvent);

  function attachOneTrustConsent() {
    if (typeof window.OneTrust !== "undefined" && typeof window.OneTrust.OnConsentChanged === "function") {
      window.OneTrust.OnConsentChanged(onConsentEvent);
    }
  }
  if (document.readyState === "loading")
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", attachOneTrustConsent);
  else
    attachOneTrustConsent();

  // If OneTrust already published a decision before this script ran, mark resolved now.
  if (getGroupsString().length > 0) markResolved();

  if (wy._isDebug) {
    notifyDebugListeners();
    logDebug("init", { strict: wy.isStrict(), groups: getGroupsString() });
  }

  wy.insertScriptForTargeting = function (url, onload) {
    wy._insertedUrls = wy._insertedUrls || {};
    function injectFallback() {
      var s = document.createElement("script");
      s.async = true;
      s.src = url;
      if (typeof onload === "function") s.onload = onload;
      (document.body || document.documentElement).appendChild(s);
    }
    function tryInsert() {
      if (!wy.canTrackAdvertising()) return;
      if (wy._insertedUrls[url]) return;
      wy._insertedUrls[url] = true;
      if (typeof window.OneTrust !== "undefined" && typeof window.OneTrust.InsertScript === "function") {
        window.OneTrust.InsertScript(url, "body", onload || function () { }, null, TARGETING_GROUP, true);
        return;
      }
      injectFallback();
    }
    tryInsert();
    wy.onTargetingChange(function (allowed) {
      if (allowed) tryInsert();
    });
  };
})(window.WyConsent);

</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
  (function () {
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('healio-ai-search-input');
    const searchButton = document.getElementById('healio-ai-search-button');
    const newBadge = document.querySelector("#dt-new-badge");

    if (!searchInput || !searchButton) {
      console.error('Healio AI search elements not found');
      return;
    }

    // Save the placeholder text
    searchInput.dataset["placeholder"] = searchInput.getAttribute("placeholder");

    function handleSearchSubmit() {
      const query = searchInput.value.trim();

      if (!query) {
        // Flash the input border to indicate empty input
        searchInput.style.outline = '2px solid #d32f2f';
        setTimeout(() => {
          searchInput.style.outline = 'none';
        }, 1500);
        searchInput.focus();
        return;
      }

      // Encode the query and navigate
      const encodedQuery = encodeURIComponent(query);
      const url = `/ai?query=${encodedQuery}&data=SG9tZXx8fGh0dHBzOi8vd3d3LmhlYWxpby5jb20vfA==`;
      window.location.href = url;
    }

    // Handle button click
    searchButton.addEventListener('click', handleSearchSubmit);

    // Handle Enter key press
    searchInput.addEventListener('keypress', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault();
        handleSearchSubmit();
      }
    });

    // Clear any error outline when user starts typing
    searchInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
      if (searchInput.style.outline) {
        searchInput.style.outline = 'none';
      }

<script type="text/javascript">
  (function() {
    const STORAGE_KEY = 'healio-ai-banner-hidden';
    const banner = document.getElementById('healio-ai-banner');
    const closeButton = document.getElementById('healio-ai-banner-close');
    const itemType = '';

    // Function to determine if banner should be shown based on item type and device
    function shouldShowBanner() {
      const deviceType = getDeviceType();
      const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const utm_medium = urlParams.get('utm_medium');
      const paidTraffic = utm_medium?.toLowerCase() === 'cpc';
      const rawPageHtml = urlParams.get('raw') === '1';

      if((itemType === "ef" && deviceType === "mobile") || paidTraffic || rawPageHtml) {
        return false;
      }

      return true;
    }

    // Function to detect device type based on screen width
    function getDeviceType() {
      return window.innerWidth <= 768 ? "mobile" : "desktop";
    }

    function getNumericValue(value) {
      if (!value) {
        return 0;
      }

      const parsed = parseInt(value.toString().replace('px', ''), 10);
      return isNaN(parsed) ? 0 : parsed;
    }

    function setElementDefaults(element, attr) {
      if (!element.dataset[attr]) {
        element.dataset[attr] = getNumericValue(window.getComputedStyle(element)[attr]).toString();
      }

      return getNumericValue(element.dataset[attr]);
    }

    function applyOffsets(elements, offset, { includePadding } = { includePadding: false }) {
      elements.forEach(el => {
        const baseTop = setElementDefaults(el, 'top');
        const newTop = baseTop + offset;
        const newHeight = `calc(100vh - ${newTop}px)`;

        el.style.setProperty('top', `${newTop}px`, 'important');
        el.style.setProperty('height', newHeight, 'important');

        if (includePadding) {
          el.style.setProperty('padding-bottom', `${newTop}px`, 'important');
        }
      });
    }

    // Function to adjust off-canvas menu position based on banner visibility
    function adjustOffCanvasPosition(isVisible) {
      const bannerOffset = isVisible
        ? (window.innerWidth >= 768 ? 80 : 60)
        : 0;

      const offCanvasMenus = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#navbarOffcanvas, .offcanvas-collapse'));
      const overlays = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.global-nav__overlay'));

      if (offCanvasMenus.length) {
        applyOffsets(offCanvasMenus, bannerOffset, { includePadding: true });
      }

      if (overlays.length) {
        applyOffsets(overlays, bannerOffset);
      }
    }

    // Check if banner element exists and if it's currently visible
    function isBannerVisible() {
      if (!banner) return false;
      const bannerDisplay = window.getComputedStyle(banner).display;
      return bannerDisplay !== 'none';
    }

    // Check session storage on page load and hide banner if needed
    function checkBannerVisibility() {
      const isHidden = sessionStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);

      const shouldShow = shouldShowBanner();

      if (isHidden === 'true' || !shouldShow) {
        if (banner) banner.style.display = 'none';
        // Remove the body padding with !important to override existing styles
        document.body.style.setProperty('padding-top', '0', 'important');
        adjustOffCanvasPosition(false);
      } else {
        if (banner) {
          banner.style.display = 'flex';
          // Remove inline padding override to let CSS handle it (CSS already sets padding-top with !important)
          document.body.style.removeProperty('padding-top');
        }
        adjustOffCanvasPosition(true);
      }
    }

    // Handle close button click
    function handleClose() {
      if (banner) banner.style.display = 'none';
      sessionStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, 'true');
      // Remove the body padding with !important to override existing styles
      document.body.style.setProperty('padding-top', '0', 'important');
      adjustOffCanvasPosition(false);
    }

    // Set up close button click handler
    if (closeButton) {
      closeButton.addEventListener('click', handleClose);
    }

    // Check visibility on load (banner is hidden by default to prevent flicker)
    // Run immediately to check storage before paint
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      // Run synchronously before first paint to prevent flicker
      checkBannerVisibility();
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', checkBannerVisibility);
    } else {
      checkBannerVisibility();
    }

    // Also adjust on window load to ensure all elements are present
    window.addEventListener('load', function() {
      adjustOffCanvasPosition(isBannerVisible());
    });

    window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
      adjustOffCanvasPosition(isBannerVisible());
    });
  })();
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  // Find all ai-link-mobile elements and apply border-gradient class to their nav-links
  const aiLinkMobileElements = document.querySelectorAll(".ai-link-mobile");

  aiLinkMobileElements.forEach((aiLink, index) => {
    const navLink = aiLink.querySelector(".nav-link");
    if (navLink) {
      navLink.classList.add("border-gradient");
    }
  });

  // Animate all border-gradient elements
  const elements = document.querySelectorAll(".border-gradient");

  if (elements.length > 0) {
    let angle = 30; // Start at 30deg (top right corner)
    let frameCount = 0;
    const rotateGradient = () => {
      // Update the gradient angle for all elements
      elements.forEach(element => {
        element.style.setProperty("--gradient-angle", `${angle}deg`);
      });

      frameCount++;

      // Check if we've completed the rotation back to 30deg
      // Start at 30, rotate 360deg (through 360 frames) to return to 30
      if (frameCount <= 360) {
        angle = (angle + 1) % 360; // Increment angle and keep it within 0-360
        requestAnimationFrame(rotateGradient); // Continue animation
      } else {
        // Remove border-gradient class from all elements after animation completes
        aiLinkMobileElements.forEach(aiLink => {
          const navLink = aiLink.querySelector(".nav-link");
          if (navLink) {
            navLink.classList.remove("border-gradient");
          }
        });
      }
    };
    rotateGradient(); // Start the animation
  }
});
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
  (function () {
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('mobile-healio-ai-search-input');
    const searchButton = document.getElementById('mobile-healio-ai-search-button');
    const newBadge = document.querySelector("#mobile-new-badge");

    if (!searchInput || !searchButton) {
      console.error('Healio AI search elements not found');
      return;
    }

    // Save the placeholder text
    searchInput.dataset["placeholder"] = searchInput.getAttribute("placeholder");

    function handleSearchSubmit() {
      const query = searchInput.value.trim();

      if (!query) {
        // Flash the input border to indicate empty input
        searchInput.style.outline = '2px solid #d32f2f';
        setTimeout(() => {
          searchInput.style.outline = 'none';
        }, 1500);
        searchInput.focus();
        return;
      }

      // Encode the query and navigate
      const encodedQuery = encodeURIComponent(query);
      const url = `/ai?query=${encodedQuery}&data=SG9tZXx8fGh0dHBzOi8vd3d3LmhlYWxpby5jb20vfA==`;
      window.location.href = url;
    }

    // Handle button click
    searchButton.addEventListener('click', handleSearchSubmit);

    // Handle Enter key press
    searchInput.addEventListener('keypress', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault();
        handleSearchSubmit();
      }
    });

    // Clear any error outline when user starts typing
    searchInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
      if (searchInput.style.outline) {
        searchInput.style.outline = 'none';
      }
    });

    // Hide the "new" badge and remove the place holder text from the input on focus
    searchInput.addEventListener('focus', () => {
      if(newBadge){
        newBadge.style.display = "none";
        searchInput.setAttribute("placeholder", "");
      }
    });

    // Reset the placeholder text if the user clicks away from the input
    searchInput.addEventListener('blur', () => {
      let placeHolderText = searchInput.dataset["placeholder"];
      if(placeHolderText) {
        searchInput.setAttribute("placeholder", placeHolderText);
      }
    });
  })();
</script>

  <script type="text/javascript">

  $(function(){
    let isMobileDevice = ((typeof window.orientation !== "undefined") || (navigator.userAgent.indexOf('IEMobile') !== -1) || (window.innerWidth < 768) || window.isMobile.any());
    let scrollContainer = document.getElementsByClassName('mobile-scrolling-menu')[0]
    let firstItem = document.querySelector('.scrolling-menu-item:first-of-type')
    let lastItem = document.querySelector('.scrolling-menu-item:last-of-type')
    let isDown = false;
    let startX;
    let x;
    let scrollLeft;

    let scrollContainerPosition = Math.ceil(scrollContainer.getBoundingClientRect().right)
    let lastItemPosition = Math.ceil(lastItem.getBoundingClientRect().right)

    if ((lastItemPosition - scrollContainerPosition) <= 6) {
      $('.right-arrow').hide();
    } else {
      $('.right-arrow').show();
    }

    function startScroll(e) {
      isDown = true;
      scrollContainer.classList.add('active');

      if (e.pageX) {
        startX = e.pageX - scrollContainer.offsetLeft;
      } else {
        startX = e.touches[0].clientX - scrollContainer.offsetLeft;
      }

      scrollLeft = scrollContainer.scrollLeft;
      scrollContainer.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
    }

    function stopScroll() {
      isDown = false;
      scrollContainer.classList.remove('active');
    }

    function activeScroll(e) {
      if (!isDown) return;

      if (e.pageX) {
        x = e.pageX - scrollContainer.offsetLeft;
      } else {
        x = e.touches[0].clientX - scrollContainer.offsetLeft;
      }

      const walk = (x - startX) * 3; //scroll-fast
      scrollContainer.scrollLeft = scrollLeft - walk;

      if (scrollContainer.scrollLeft == 0) {
        $('.left-arrow').hide();
      } else {
        $('.left-arrow').show();
      }

      let scrollContainerPosition = Math.ceil(scrollContainer.getBoundingClientRect().right)
      let lastItemPosition = Math.ceil(lastItem.getBoundingClientRect().right)

      if ((lastItemPosition - scrollContainerPosition) <= 6) {
        $('.right-arrow').hide();
      } else {
        $('.right-arrow').show();
      }
    }

    scrollContainer.addEventListener('mouseenter', (e) => {
      if (isMobileDevice) {
        scrollContainer.style.cursor = 'grab';
      }
    });

    if (isMobileDevice) {
      scrollContainer.addEventListener('mousedown',
        (e) => {
          startScroll(e);
        });
      scrollContainer.addEventListener('touchstart',
        (e) => {
          startScroll(e);
        });
      scrollContainer.addEventListener('mouseleave', stopScroll);
      scrollContainer.addEventListener('mouseup', stopScroll);
      scrollContainer.addEventListener('touchend', stopScroll)
      scrollContainer.addEventListener('mousemove',
        (e) => {
          activeScroll(e);
        });
      scrollContainer.addEventListener('touchmove',
        (e) => {
          activeScroll(e);
        });
    }

    window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
      let scrollContainerPosition = Math.ceil(scrollContainer.getBoundingClientRect().right)
      let lastItemPosition = Math.ceil(lastItem.getBoundingClientRect().right)

      if (isMobileDevice) {
        if ((lastItemPosition - scrollContainerPosition) <= 6) {
          $('.right-arrow').hide();
        } else {
          $('.right-arrow').show();
        }

        if (scrollContainer.scrollLeft == 0) {
          $('.left-arrow').hide();
        } else {
          $('.left-arrow').show();
        }
      }
    })
  })
</script>

      $("#iKnownInfo").on("click", function () {

        $("#knownInfoModal").modal();
      });

      $('#knownInfoModal .modal-dialog').on('click', function(e){
        e.stopPropagation();

    function afterGlobalsEsu() {
      if (window.UserProfile.isLoggedIn === "True") {
        $("input#listEmailAddress").val(window.UserProfile.email);
        $(".update-link").removeClass("d-none");
        $(".email-address b").html(window.UserProfile.email);
        $("#divEmailGroups").addClass("known-user");
        $('.input-target input.ellipsis').attr('tabindex', '-1')

        let emailInputEllipsis = document.querySelector('input.ellipsis')
        if(emailInputEllipsis && emailInputEllipsis.offsetWidth < emailInputEllipsis.scrollWidth) {
          $('.long-email-tooltip').text(emailInputEllipsis.value)

          //checks for mobile device
          if(window.orientation > -1) {
            $('.input-target').on('click', function(){
                $('.long-email-tooltip').toggle();
            })

            $('body').on('click', function(e){
                if(e.target == document.querySelector('.input-target')) {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                } else {
                    $('.long-email-tooltip').hide();
                }
            })
          } else {
            $('.input-target').mouseenter(function(){
                $('.long-email-tooltip').show();
            })

            $('.input-target').mouseleave(function(){
                $('.long-email-tooltip').hide();
            })
          }
        }
      } else {
        $('input#listEmailAddress').after('<div class="placeholder">Enter your email</div>');       
        $('.placeholder').on('click', function(){
          $(this).prev('input[type="email"]').focus();
        })
      }
    }

    (function () {
      'use strict';
      window.addEventListener('load', function () {
        // Fetch all the forms we want to apply custom Bootstrap validation styles to
        var forms = document.getElementsByClassName('footer-sign-up-form');
        // Loop over them and prevent submission
        var validation = Array.prototype.filter.call(forms, function (form) {
          form.addEventListener('submit', function (event) {
            if (form.checkValidity() === false) {
              event.preventDefault();
              event.stopPropagation();
            }
            form.classList.add('was-validated');
          }, false);
        });
      }, false);
    })();

    numberOfOptions = $('.footer-signup .email-signup select').children('option').length;

    $('.footer-signup .email-signup select').addClass('select-hidden');
    $('.footer-signup .email-signup select').wrap('<div class="select"></div>');

    $('.footer-signup .email-signup select').after('<div class="invalid-feedback">Choose your specialty</div>');

    $('.footer-signup .email-signup select.is-invalid').after('<div class="select-styled is-invalid"></div>');
    $('.footer-signup .email-signup select:not(.is-invalid)').after('<div class="select-styled"></div>');


    var styledSelect = $('.footer-signup .email-signup select').next('div.select-styled');
    styledSelect.html('Choose your specialty<span>*</span>');



    var list = $('<ul />', {
      'class': 'select-options'
    }).insertAfter(styledSelect);

    for (var i = 0; i < numberOfOptions; i++) {
      $('<li />', {
        text: $('.footer-signup .email-signup select').children('option').eq(i).text(),
        rel: $('.footer-signup .email-signup select').children('option').eq(i).val()
      }).appendTo(list);
      if ($('.footer-signup .email-signup select').children('option').eq(i).is(':selected')) {
        $('li[rel="' + $('.footer-signup .email-signup select').children('option').eq(i).val() + '"]').addClass('is-selected')
      }
    }

    var listItems = list.children('li');

    styledSelect.click(function (e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      $('div.select-styled.active').not($(this)).each(function () {
        $(this).removeClass('active').next('ul.select-options').hide();
      });
      $(this).toggleClass('active').next('ul.select-options').toggle();
    });

    let selectElem = $('.footer-signup .email-signup select');
    listItems.click(function (e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      styledSelect.html('<div class="ellipsis">' + $(this).html() + '</div>').removeClass('active');
      $(selectElem).val($(this).attr('rel'));
      list.hide();
    });

    $(document).click(function () {
      styledSelect.removeClass('active');
      list.hide();
    });

    $('.known-user .input-target input').attr('tabindex', '-1')
    $('.update-link i').on('keypress', function(e){
      if(e.keyCode == 13) {
        $(this).click();
        $('#knownInfoModal .close').focus();
      }
    })
